001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.ShopPermissionAudience;
005import com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.Locale;
010
011import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.ACCESS_INVENTORY;
012import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.PREVIEW_SHOP;
013import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.PURCHASE;
014import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.RECEIVE_ALERT;
015import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SEARCH;
016import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_BENEFIT;
017import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_CURRENCY;
018import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_ITEM;
019import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_PRICE;
020import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_SHOPTYPE;
021import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_SIGN_TYPE;
022import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_STACK_AMOUNT;
023import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SHOW_INFORMATION;
024import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.TOGGLE_DISPLAY;
025import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.VIEW_PURCHASE_LOGS;
026
027public enum BuiltInShopPermissionGroup implements ShopPermissionAudience {
028  BLOCKED("blocked", "blocked"),
029  EVERYONE("everyone", "everyone", PURCHASE, SHOW_INFORMATION, PREVIEW_SHOP, SEARCH),
030  STAFF("staff", "staff", PURCHASE, SHOW_INFORMATION, PREVIEW_SHOP, SEARCH, ACCESS_INVENTORY,
031        TOGGLE_DISPLAY, SET_SHOPTYPE, SET_PRICE, SET_ITEM, SET_STACK_AMOUNT,
032        SET_CURRENCY, RECEIVE_ALERT, SET_BENEFIT, SET_SIGN_TYPE, VIEW_PURCHASE_LOGS),
033  ADMINISTRATOR("administrator", "administrator", BuiltInShopPermission.values());
034
035  private final String node;
036  private final String descriptionKey;
037  private final List<BuiltInShopPermission> permissions;
038
039  BuiltInShopPermissionGroup(@NotNull final String node, @NotNull final String descriptionKey, @NotNull final BuiltInShopPermission... permissions) {
040
041    this.node = node;
042    this.descriptionKey = descriptionKey;
043    this.permissions = ImmutableList.copyOf(permissions);
044  }
045
046  @NotNull
047  public String getDescriptionKey() {
048
049    return descriptionKey;
050  }
051
052  @Override
053  public @NotNull String getName() {
054
055    return this.descriptionKey;
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Check specific permission is/or contains the given permission.
060   *
061   * @param permission The permission to check.
062   *
063   * @return True if the given permission is/or contains the given permission.
064   */
065  @Override
066  public boolean hasPermission(@NotNull final BuiltInShopPermission permission) {
067
068    return this.getPermissions().contains(permission);
069  }
070
071  @Override
072  public boolean hasPermission(@NotNull final String permission) {
073
074    return node.contains(permission);
075  }
076
077  @NotNull
078  public List<BuiltInShopPermission> getPermissions() {
079
080    return permissions;
081  }
082
083  @NotNull
084  public String getNamespacedNode() {
085
086    return QuickShopAPI.getPluginInstance().getName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) + "." + this.node;
087  }
088
089  @NotNull
090  public String getRawNode() {
091
092    return node;
093  }
094}
